title: Driving Merchant Adoption of Digital Payment Solutions Through Customer Success Management
eligible_reason: Three-arm randomized field experiment (control, T1 system integration, T2 value realization; 479 Mexican retailers) analysed with cross-sectional endline regressions: reg digpay_solution_used treat_si treat_vr [$firmx $ownerx $batchx], cluster(CodigoPostal4_scr), plus heterogeneity interactions with digital-capacity indices and probit/logit variants. The only panel data (Transactions_Clean_NoPII.dta, firm-month digital payments) cover T1/T2 firms only, with random-effects xtreg/xtpoisson of monthly usage on treatment2 and controls; there is no pre-period outcome and no staggered adoption.
design_notes: Baseline audit (DigPay_Baseline), treatment assignment by strata/batch (TreatmentBatch; batch2-batch9 dummies as controls), 12-month post-intervention audit, transaction records for treated firms, spillover audit of neighbours (reghdfe neighbor_adopted any_treatment, a(CodigoPostal4_scr)). Tables 3-6 main text; WA6-WA22 web appendix. 'ft_staggered' flag is a false positive (batches of enrollment).
n_adoption_cohorts_note: No staggered binary adoption in the reported designs.

specs.exclusion_reason: RCT endline cross-section; no unit-specific adoption dates; no unit/time FE
specs.sample_condition: midbo_operational==2 (operational at midline) in some tables

data_files: Cleaned Data No PII/Main_Clean_NoPII.dta (0.7 MB), Transactions_Clean_NoPII.dta (2.1 MB), Spillovers_Clean_NoPII.dta, VR_Ratings_Clean_NoPII.dta, Distances_Clean_NoPII.dta
Analysis Code/*.do (37 files), Tables/*.tex, Figures/*.png, Logs/*.smcl, README.rtf
data_files_note: Anonymized participant data with scrambled zip-code cluster identifiers (README/Table 6.do note); outcome data are real. Census microdata (WA Table 5, WA Table 2 row 1, Appendix C1) and GPS data (WA Table 13) omitted.
software_notes: Stata 18 (reg, probit, logit, xtreg, xtpoisson, reghdfe, bootstrap, esttab).
screener_notes: Screened from package only (README.rtf, Table 4-6.do, Figure 2.do, regression list of 211 commands). RCT without a staggered rollout in the analysis.
